fields.title: 2. Share Count Changes by Holding — 2Q26 → 3Q26
fields.md:
Share counts are the sum of the rows for the same holding in the information table (rows split by manager). 2Q26 source: [Information table 2026-08-14](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526352200/56757.xml). 3Q26 source: [Information table 2026-11-16](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526463399/60471.xml). The row-by-row value totals of the two information tables are $299.254 billion and $304.197 billion respectively, matching the totals in the source documents (formula check).

| Holding | 2Q26 shares | 3Q26 shares | Change | Change % (formula) | 3Q26 fair value ($ million) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bank of America | 483,394,015 | 455,860,908 | −27,533,107 | −5.7% | 24,812.5 |

| Kroger | 39,000,000 | 35,000,000 | −4,000,000 | −10.3% | 2,051.7 |
| Nucor | 1,857,752 | 1,580,776 | −276,976 | −14.9% | 369.5 |

Source: the two information tables above (SEC, 2026-08-14 · 2026-11-16). Change % formula = change ÷ 2Q26 shares.

**Unchanged share counts** (source: the same two information tables): Apple 227,917,808 · American Express 151,610,700 · Coca-Cola 400,000,000 · Alphabet A 78,791,167·C 27,188,433 · Chevron 84,375,856 · Occidental Petroleum 264,941,431 · Chubb 34,249,183 · Moody's 24,669,778 · Kraft Heinz 325,634,818 · Sirius XM 124,807,117 · Ally 27,000,000 · The New York Times 15,700,000 · Liberty Live A 4,986,588·C 10,587,143 · Louisiana-Pacific 5,664,793 · NVR 11,112 · Jefferies 433,558 · D.R. Horton 3,564.

Answers to the three questions T1 asked:
- **Alphabet**: Share counts unchanged for both A and C — neither increased nor reduced in 3Q. Combined fair value at the end of 3Q was $36.37 billion (formula 27,110.5 + 9,264.2, source: [3Q information table](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526463399/60471.xml)).
- **Apple**: Share count unchanged at 227,917,808 shares, fair value $75.90 billion — No. 1 in the 13F (source: the same information table).
- **Bank stocks**: Bank of America was cut by 5.7% and Capital One by 61.7%, while Ally and American Express were unchanged (source: the two information tables; formulas in the table above).
